name: cortex
description: Durable local coordination ledger for model-owned multi-agent governance.

interface.longDescription: Cortex 1.12.2 provides 22 advisory agent profiles and a local durable coordination ledger. It exposes exactly 15 uniform semantic operations for project-scoped tasks, model-authored assignments, immutable worker publications, pending and recorded user decisions, governance assessments, and advisory closure. The coordinator model owns decomposition, host-neutral dispatch mapping, exact model and effort selection, governance depth, rework, verification, and the final answer. The activation guard and sanitized lifecycle observer provide host-side ordering and bounded observation only; native spawn input remains host-owned and authoritative worker context is delivered at SubagentStart. The ledger enforces data integrity, idempotency, project isolation, and bounded validation; governance records never become lifecycle gates.
interface.defaultPrompt: Coordinate this task with Cortex 1.12.2 using durable worker evidence, proportional governance, and verified closure.
